rate_rule: K3P schedule when mobility is 0; else pull each multiplier toward max(schedule, 0.20), never below the schedule
mix_rule: s uses the scheduled network multiplier, not the data-boosted applied LR
anchor_rule: K3P prox and decay 0.999; mobility does not scale the anchor
noise: inherited K3P horizon noise; labeled intermediate, not horizon-independent
limit: real-mean innovation cannot detect generator-side forgetting or a mean-preserving change
budget_dependencies: K3P network/prior multipliers still read total_steps, anneal start, floors, and network_lr_horizon_cap
input and output noise still anneal on the driver noise_horizon (1200 on these ring drivers)
mobility, the z threshold, and the 0.20 ceiling do not read the budget or the shift time
